records.label: spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores#1
records.source: Reads the ``measurements.db`` produced by :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges cell/nucleus/pathogen/ cytoplasm feature tables, uses the wells marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a plate heatmap into ``results/`` next to the source DB.
records.context: Reads the ``measurements.db`` produced by :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, merges cell/nucleus/pathogen/ cytoplasm feature tables, uses the microplate sample positions marked as ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (or an annotation column) as training labels, delegates fitting to :func:`ml_analysis`, and writes per-object predictions, permutation and feature-importance tables plus a laboratory microplate heatmap into ``results/`` next to the source DB.
records.translation: Lê o ``measurements.db`` produzido por :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop`, mescla as tabelas de características de célula/núcleo/patógeno/citoplasma, usa os poços marcados como ``positive_control`` / ``negative_control`` (ou uma coluna de anotação) como rótulos de treinamento, delega o ajuste a :func:`ml_analysis` e grava previsões por objeto, tabelas de permutação e importância de características, além de um mapa de calor da placa, em ``results/`` ao lado do banco de dados de origem.

records.label: spacr.ml.regression_levels#4
records.source: Two fits, two tables, TWO CORRECTIONS. Each fit is its own multiple-testing family and is corrected within itself. Pooling them would be wrong twice over: they are not independent -- same wells, and the gene regressor IS the sum of the guide regressors -- and doubling the family size costs power for no protection. :func:`perform_regression` applies the correction per level and writes ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv``.
records.context: Two fits, two tables, TWO CORRECTIONS. Each fit is its own multiple-testing family and is corrected within itself. Pooling them would be wrong twice over: they are not independent -- same microplate sample positions, and the gene regressor IS the sum of the guide regressors -- and doubling the family size costs power for no protection. :func:`perform_regression` applies the correction per level and writes ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv``.
records.translation: Dois ajustes, duas tabelas, DUAS CORREÇÕES. Cada ajuste constitui sua própria família de testes múltiplos e é corrigido internamente. Agrupá-los seria duplamente errado: eles não são independentes -- mesmos poços, e o regressor do gene É a soma dos regressores dos guias -- e duplicar o tamanho da família reduz o poder sem oferecer proteção. :func:`perform_regression` aplica a correção por nível e grava ``results_grna.csv`` e ``results_gene.csv``.

Its guide output is BLUPs, which is why it cannot be split into two testing families.
records.context: ``regression_type='mixed'`` fits ONCE and returns one entry, ``'gene'``: that model has both levels inside it already, the gene as a fixed effect and the guide as a random effect nested in the gene. records.label: spacr.ml.resolve_auto_inference#0
records.source: Choose ``analysis_mode`` for ``inference='auto'`` from the design.

records.translation: Escolha ``analysis_mode`` para  ``inference='auto'`` a partir do design.

records.label: spacr.ml.resolve_auto_inference#1
records.source: The simultaneous model estimates one coefficient per guide from the wells, so it needs more wells than guides -- with an intercept and any plate fixed effects on top -- before those coefficients are identifiable at all. Below that the design matrix is rank deficient: statsmodels still returns a number for every guide, but the numbers are one arbitrary solution out of infinitely many, and their P values describe nothing.
records.context: The simultaneous model estimates one coefficient per guide from the microplate sample positions, so it needs more microplate sample positions than guides -- with an intercept and any laboratory microplate fixed effects on top -- before those coefficients are identifiable at all. Below that the design matrix is rank deficient: statsmodels still returns a number for every guide, but the numbers are one arbitrary solution out of infinitely many, and their P values describe nothing.
records.translation: O modelo simultâneo estima um coeficiente por guia a partir dos poços, portanto precisa de mais poços do que guias -- além de um intercepto e de quaisquer efeitos fixos da placa -- para que esses coeficientes sejam identificáveis. Abaixo desse ponto, a matriz de delineamento tem posto deficiente: statsmodels ainda retorna um número para cada guia, mas os números são uma solução arbitrária entre infinitas possibilidades, e seus valores de P nada descrevem.

records.label: spacr.ml.resolve_auto_inference#2
records.source: That is not a hypothetical. The screen this was written for has 824 guides in 587 analysed wells; the published fit had 825 parameters, rank 579 and 8 residual degrees of freedom, and refitting it did not reproduce its own coefficients.
records.context: That is not a hypothetical. The screen this was written for has 824 guides in 587 analysed microplate sample positions; the published fit had 825 parameters, rank 579 and 8 residual degrees of freedom, and refitting it did not reproduce its own coefficients.
records.translation: Isso não é hipotético. A triagem para a qual isto foi escrito tem 824 guias em 587 poços analisados; o ajuste publicado tinha 825 parâmetros, posto 579 e 8 graus de liberdade residuais, e reajustá-lo não reproduziu seus próprios coeficientes.

records.label: spacr.ml.resolve_auto_inference#3
records.source: ``auto`` therefore picks the permutation test whenever the simultaneous fit would be unidentifiable, and says so. It is deliberately conservative: it needs a real margin (``_IDENTIFIABILITY_MARGIN`` wells per guide) rather than a bare majority, because a design that only just fits is one dropped well away from not fitting.
records.context: ``auto`` therefore picks the permutation test whenever the simultaneous fit would be unidentifiable, and says so. It is deliberately conservative: it needs a real margin (``_IDENTIFIABILITY_MARGIN`` microplate sample positions per guide) rather than a bare majority, because a design that only just fits is one dropped well away from not fitting.
records.translation: ``auto``, portanto, escolhe o teste de permutação sempre que o ajuste simultâneo não seria identificável e informa essa decisão. A escolha é deliberadamente conservadora: exige uma margem real (``_IDENTIFIABILITY_MARGIN`` poços por guia), em vez de uma maioria simples, porque um delineamento que mal pode ser ajustado está a apenas um poço descartado de deixar de ser ajustável.

records.source: Every key :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression` reads with ``settings[...]`` is filled here. Six were not, and because both dispatchers (the Qt panel via ``qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`` and ``spacr-run regression`` via ``cli.module_defaults``) build the dict from this one function, regression could not be started from any entry point: it died on ``KeyError: 'verbose'`` at ml.py:1409, after both input CSVs had been read and ``settings/regression.csv`` had been written, so the failure looked like a run that had started cleanly.
records.context: Every structured-data name :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression` reads with ``settings[...]`` is filled here. Six were not, and because both dispatchers (the Qt panel via ``qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`` and ``spacr-run regression`` via ``cli.module_defaults``) build the key-value mapping from this one function, regression could not be started from any entry point: it died on ``KeyError: 'verbose'`` at ml.py:1409, after both input CSVs had been read and ``settings/regression.csv`` had been written, so the failure looked like a processing session that had started cleanly.
records.translation: Cada chave que :func:`spacr.ml.perform_regression` lê com ``settings[...]`` é preenchida aqui. Seis chaves não eram preenchidas e, como ambos os despachantes (o painel Qt por meio de ``qt.screens.settings_model.resolve_default_settings`` e ``spacr-run regression`` por meio de ``cli.module_defaults``) constroem o dicionário a partir desta única função, não era possível iniciar a regressão por nenhum ponto de entrada: ela terminava com ``KeyError: 'verbose'`` em ml.py:1409, depois que ambos os CSVs de entrada já haviam sido lidos e ``settings/regression.csv`` havia sido gravado, fazendo a falha parecer uma execução iniciada corretamente.
